maes_1.why: Simultaneous equations require understanding of multiple relationships between variables; I am moderately comfortable with this concept.

maes_2.why: Decimals are straightforward for me; basic operations like addition and subtraction are manageable.

maes_3.why: Determining missing angles is a fundamental geometry skill that I am very confident in.

maes_4.why: Algebra problems involve applying rules and solving for unknowns; my mathematical foundation supports this skill.

maes_5.why: Trigonometry extends beyond basic geometry into functions and periodic behavior; I am somewhat confident in my ability.

maes_6.why: Calculating area and volume involves applying formulas to shapes and spaces; this is a practical skill I rely on.

maes_7.why: Sketching curves requires visualizing functions and their behavior; my drawing skills are limited in this context.

maes_8.why: Working with fractions involves understanding parts of a whole; basic arithmetic is manageable for me.

maes_9.why: Determining missing side lengths often requires solving equations; I am moderately confident but prone to errors in complex problems.
